name: Kender
traits: True kender are Small and move 30 feet on land. Dexterity increases by 2, and Strength and Wisdom each decrease by 2. Small size improves attacks and AC by 1 and Hide by 4, and reduces weapon size and carrying capacity.
Treat exotic kender weapons as simple. Gain +1 on all saves, +2 to Spot, and +2 to Open Lock and Sleight of Hand. Those last two skills can be used without ranks.
True kender ignore both mundane and magical fear. Add +4 to Bluff when taunting and take a –4 racial penalty to Concentration.
Afflicted kender retain the shared base traits. Remove fear immunity, the taunt bonus, and the Concentration penalty. Add +2 to each of Climb, Hide, Jump, and Move Silently.
Common and Kenderspeak are automatic. Bonus language choices are Dwarven, Ergot, Elven, Goblin, and Solamnic. Rogue is favored.

name: Tarmak
traits: Tarmaks are Medium human humanoids with 30-foot land movement, +2 Strength, –2 Intelligence, and –2 Charisma.
Choose an extra 1st-level feat from the fighter bonus-feat list. Spend the extra 4 starting skill points and the 1 extra point at later levels on Strength-, Dexterity-, or Constitution-based skills.
Tarmakian is automatic. Common, Damjatt, Keena, and Nerakese are bonus language choices. Barbarian is favored.
A Tarmak can qualify for the Hulking Brute feat in the Dragonlance Campaign Setting. Large size benefits are not automatic.

name: Kyrie
traits: The full Kyrie package is Medium, with –2 Strength, +6 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, 20-foot land speed, 50-foot good flight, darkvision 60 feet and +2 natural armor.

The full package has 4d8 monstrous humanoid Hit Dice, +4 BAB, base saves Fort +1, Ref +4 and Will +4, two racial feats and 7 × (2 + Int modifier) racial skill points. Handle Animal, Knowledge (nature), Listen, Spot and Survival are class skills.

Full Kyrie cast and gain a domain as 3rd-level mystics. Their effective level starts at 7, comprising 4 racial HD and +3 level adjustment. Auran and Kothian are automatic, with Common, Kalinese and Nordmaarian as bonus choices. Mystic is favored.

The seven-tier Kyrie racial class is the alternative starting route. Level 1 starts at –2 Strength and +2 Dexterity, with one racial HD, gliding, a feat and a mystic domain power. It takes all seven levels before multiclassing.

The racial class gains mystic casting at tiers 2, 4 and 6. True flight starts at tier 3 at 20 feet (clumsy), improves at tier 5 to 30 feet (average) and reaches 50 feet (good) at tier 7. Natural armor begins at +1 at tier 3 and improves to +2 at tier 7. The class ends with 4d8 racial HD.
At tiers 2 and 6 the class adds +2 Dexterity. Tier 4 adds +2 Wisdom and the second feat. The fourth racial Hit Die arrives at tier 6.

From tier 1 to 7 the Kyrie class table gives BAB +1/+2/+2/+3/+3/+4/+4 and CR 1/1/2/2/2/3/3. Fortitude bases are +0/+0/+0/+1/+1/+1/+1. Reflex and Will each use +2/+3/+3/+3/+3/+4/+4. Skill points arrive at each gained racial Hit Die.

name: Phaethon
traits: Phaethons are Medium humanoids with the elf and fire subtypes, –2 Strength, and +2 Wisdom. Low-light vision doubles human sight distance in dim light.
Land speed is 30 feet. Manifest fire wings as a free supernatural action without provoking. The wings enable 60-foot average flight and use character level as their effective caster level.
With wings manifested, add 1d6 fire to an unarmed hit or to damage dealt as the result of a grapple check. A round using the added fire damage cannot also include flight with those wings.

Fire subtype gives fire immunity and cold vulnerability. Common and Elven are automatic. Bonus language choices are Celestial, Draconic, Dwarven, Ignan and Sylvan. Monk is favored. Level adjustment is +2.
